datasheet.measures: flow velocity of water, glycol, oils and air
datasheet.source: ifm datasheet SA5000-00 (09.10.2015): liquids measuring range 0.04...3 m/s, setting range 0...6 m/s (relative mode); gases 2...100 m/s, setting 0...200 m/s; IO-Link 1.1, master port A, DeviceID 533 (REL), 540 (LIQU), 547 (GAS); drawing 34 mm diameter, 49.4 mm deep, about 142 mm long incl. 45 mm probe. IO-Link setting range from IODD ifm-000215-20161025-IODD1.1.xml: SP1 5–100 %, rP1 0–96 % of the measuring range end; defaults 20 % and 15 %.

options.name: Operating mode
options.source: ifm SA5000 datasheet: operating modes REL, LIQU and GAS are separate DeviceIDs (533, 540, 547). In the IODD the mode is read-only (ModE, index 689, factory REL), so it is not a writable parameter.
